turns.content: Generating a deterministic noise PNG in the VFS.

arguments.command: mkdir -p /workspace/viewtest; node -e "const S=512;const c=new OffscreenCanvas(S,S);const x=c.getContext('2d');const d=x.createImageData(S,S);let s=1234567;for(let i=0;i<d.data.length;i+=4){s=(s*1103515245+12345)>>>0;d.data[i]=s&255;d.data[i+1]=(s>>>8)&255;d.data[i+2]=(s>>>16)&255;d.data[i+3]=255;}x.putImageData(d,0,0);const b=await c.convertToBlob({type:'image/png'});const buf=new Uint8Array(await b.arrayBuffer());require('fs').writeFileSync('/workspace/viewtest/noise.png',buf);console.log('bytes '+buf.length);"; ls -l /workspace/viewtest
